name: graph-connector-factory
description: Unified MCP server for Graph Connector Factory — research, generate, and deploy Power Platform custom connectors from Microsoft Graph API.

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const s=p.resolve('src/tools/agent/templates'),d=p.resolve('dist/tools/agent/templates');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(s).forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(p.join(s,f),p.join(d,f)));console.log('Copied agent templates to dist/')"
